svg.title: TOPAK B7 — From genesis to bootstrap: where the corpus stands at G11
svg.desc: The design process is genesis, not a degeneracy (ADR-0029): one custodian ratifies, the risky part is tracked as debt, and the anchor may bootstrap once a drafted TLA+ specification exists and the whole corpus has been independently reviewed. Since Batch 34 a record may be ratified provisional, and the ceremony gains two steps: seating the first operators, and floor fitness. This is the G11 state (2026.10.09); diagrams/g1-to-bootstrap-2026.09.18.svg shows the earlier G1 state.
svg.text: TOPAK · B7

text.tspan: From genesis to bootstrap: where the corpus stands at G11

svg.text: The design process is genesis, not a degeneracy (ADR-0029): one custodian ratifies, the risky part is tracked as debt, and the anchor may bootstrap once a drafted TLA+ specification exists and the whole corpus has been independently reviewed. Since Batch 34 a record may be ratified provisional, and the ceremony gains two steps: seating the first operators, and floor fitness. This is the G11 state (2026.10.09);
diagrams/g1-to-bootstrap-2026.09.18.svg shows the earlier G1 state.
Custody declared: Scott, sole custodian, (1, 0) (§1). Genesis custody, not a degeneracy: no
archetype custody exists before the anchor does.
Unilateral ratification of any record with decision text (§2); a record without it cannot be ratified.
Ratification is available, not required.
Since A4, provisional: ratified without meeting its own condition, in force and subject to
redesign, its exit stated (§3).
Everything ratified is trusted by declaration and joins the genesis TCB. No forcing function
(§7): every checkpoint carries a debt ledger.
(a) and (b) met
(a) a drafted TLA+ bootstrap specification: five modules, five invariants, a mutation each that
must fail (§5). Two of five drafted, checked, proved and certified, and proved in Lean too
(ADR-0053); BreakGlass_A1 succeeds the second where it models X1.
(b) an independent review of the entire corpus at one named manifest digest, by at least one
reviewer who is not the author, every finding dispositioned (A2.1). Not met: no reviewer is
engaged and no pass has been run (G11 §4).
Permission, not obligation: bootstrap happens when the custodian declares it and the trigger
is met (§7).
custodian declares
Seat the key-holders under a declared custody record, and the first operators by issuance, at
least three in each domain at the archetype (A3, provisional).
Floor fitness (A4, step 6): the bootstrap reviewer establishes that the policy floor is fit, in the
attestation, and with that the floor is ratified.
Assemble the genesis bundle; every key-holder signs its digest: issuance epoch 0
The genesis bundle is the only artifact never promoted; the genesis rules are checked by
GenesisSatisfiesFloor, not a promotion (ADR-0027 §2).
epoch 0 issued
Each confirmation-required record passes a confirmation promotion under ADR-0024 with
author recusal, in dependency order (§6).
Confirmed: becomes Accepted; the marker is removed. Rejected: a superseding record is
required.
A provisional record also stops being provisional only when its debt is built and seen and a
reader has reviewed it; the custodian records it (§3, A4).
The bootstrap set (0024–0027) can never carry the marker: confirmation runs under it (§4).
18 unmarked + 27 confirmation-required + 2 provisional. Ratified in part:
ADR-0022 only (§6 Proposed); ADR-0042 is whole
Up from 28: 27, adding 0053 (C4, for one route), and the two provisional
records
ADR-0050 and ADR-0052, Batch 34: in force, subject to redesign,
confirmation-required (ADR-0029 A4)
ADR-0035, ADR-0036, ADR-0051; ADR-0054 and ADR-0055 (workflows,
built at the reference); and ADR-0022 §6
ADR-0011 tombstone; ADR-0014 reserved, no file

54 record files, numbered to 0055; three added since G10 (0053 to 0055); 0014 is the only reserved number. Twelve amendments are pending, up from none, every one on a Proposed record: ten of ADR-0054's and ADR-0033 A16, A17; ADR-0026 A1, R8, was withdrawn (W1, 2026.10.04). Two batches since G10, 36 and 37. Ratified in part is distinct from ADR-0018, which is accepted and reversed in part by ADR-0037 §3 (G11 §1.2, as at G9). 18 + 27 + 2 accepted, 5 Proposed, 1
superseded and 1 tombstone make the 54 files.

text.tspan: C1 · carries a proof obligation over privileged paths (erasure, break-glass,

svg.text: 0013, 0028, and the accepted 0006 and 0009

text.tspan: C2 · carries an exhaustiveness or confinement claim
C3 · supersedes, or reverses in effect, an accepted record

svg.text: 0008 supersession; 0017 ordering-clause supersession

text.tspan: C4 · resolves a debt owed by an accepted record

svg.text: 0013 (debts of 0006 and 0009)

Marked on ratification if any applies. Until confirmed, a publication citing the guarantee says "author-ratified", and of a provisional record "author-ratified, provisional". Minimum set: 0013, 0028, 0015, 0022 §6 (whenever ratified), the two
supersession records (whenever written), 0006 and 0009 retroactively. A provisional record is confirmation-required whatever its content (§3, A4).
Ratified by the custodian and trusted by declaration. Post-bootstrap it changes only through promotion.
As above, plus a confirmation promotion after bootstrap (§6).
Unratified; may stay Proposed indefinitely.
Ratified, in force and subject to redesign; did not meet its own ratification condition and says on its face what it lacked. Confirmation-required. Stops being provisional
when the debt is built and seen at the reference and a reader who is not the drafter has reviewed it; the custodian records it by a History row.

A provisional record's amendments may land in the bootstrap set (§4, A4), and three do: ADR-0024 A3, ADR-0025 A3, ADR-0026 A2. Not confirmation-required, for the reason the set cannot be; covered by the genesis attestation, which
names them as provisional. Markings with no criterion: ADR-0035 R2 (Proposed), by custodian instruction; and assisted drafting, on which nearly everything ratified since G9 rests (item 66).

text.tspan: The genesis debt ledger: all 29 confirmation-required records (G11 §4, with G10's 28)
Why it is marked; what changed since G9 (Status note; G10 §4, §6; G11 §4, §6)

svg.text: Topic per principal per round, sealed on emit, as the unit of erasure
C1 · A2 only
A2 adds the after companion topic to the unit of erasure: a claim over the erasure path
Kafka is neither the ordering authority nor the system of record
Discharges the debt ADR-0033 §2's K row carried since Batch 7, and ADR-0015's open item 1 as it bore on ordering. New at G10
Erasure is a privileged, modeled, consensus-ordered event
Marked retroactively under C1 (ADR-0029 §4 minimum set); its debt resolved by ADR-0013
Break-glass is a modeled, quorum-witnessed path, not a prohibition
As ADR-0006: a privileged path. A1 (provisional with ADR-0052): the path stays and is a seating, no longer a floor exception
Exception mechanism for privileged paths through the floor
Resolves the debts of 0006 and 0009; NC-1, NC-2 proved. A1 (provisional): a grant ends with its round; the exception count is 1; NC restated in NonComposition_A1
Effects are boundary crossings; every crossing is authorized, ordered, and auditable
Both sets claimed exhaustive; the effect set's exhaustiveness unenforced while the sandbox gap stands
Build emits to the effect stream; Build has an Observer
ADR-0039 §3, accepted, couples Build's promotion to the seal this record defines
Degeneracy as the deployment-variation relation; archetype as its unique maximum
§5 reverses in effect ADR-0008's Observer scoping and ADR-0017's ordering-primacy clause. A1: the declared rung is per seat (§6c)
The forensic floor: authority facts survive erasure and break-glass
Proof obligation over privileged paths; four open obligations carried into confirmation
The design process is genesis; unilateral ratification; bootstrap on a drafted TLA+ spec
C3 · A2 and A4 only
A2 reverses two clauses (the full-corpus review); A4 adds a way to ratify the phase did not have: provisional, and floor fitness at bootstrap
Bundles cannot add authority by construction; the floor runs on a verified evaluator
Floor exceptions and forensic classes in the floor language; A1 the checker; A2 label attributes in S and the allowlist's load checks; A3 the floor genesis-provisional
The lease is the composite credential, and its grant is the instant
§5 lapses break-glass approvals on a targeted revocation; A1 confinement across renewal. A3 (C1, C3; provisional): who grants and who denies
Confinement is attested at lease grant; the archetype rung is a confidential VM
A confinement claim; resolves ADR-0031's attestation-rung debt. A2, the Run profile (with ADR-0042 §6) and A3, four choices of the reference, now ratified (G10 §4)
The LTRO decomposes into principals: seats and stages
§3 reverses in effect ADR-0018's Reader scope correction. A2–A4: the Listener labels and delivers the list; the kinds emergency and operator
Observers are per cell, the shared group becomes the correlator
Supersedes ADR-0008; discharges ADR-0023's carried scope for that supersession
Observer liveness is progress, not presence
Resolves ADR-0024's open obligation on veto-seat outage. A2 (provisional): an emergency seat is not coupled
Run has its own alphabet: Consult, Actuate, Report
Reverses in effect ADR-0022 §5's sentence that Read and Emit are common. A1: the root declares a label; the entry's form
Policy obligations for Run: one envelope per variant, coupling on effects only
A1 R5–R7; A2 X1 retired; A3 C1–C9; A2 and A3 provisional
Mechanism obligations for Run (whole, §6 since B30)
Resolves ADR-0039 finding 3 in part; §6, Run's confinement claim, ratified with the Run profile, carries C2. A2: seatKind
Cell obligations for Run
Resolves the provisional Run column of ADR-0037 §4. A1, A2: four items and handles; what carries the task
A bundle is trusted by its signature, not its file name
§3 is a check on the privileged path. Drafted by the assistant
The trusted base is declared row by row
Annex A claims to enumerate what the theorems assume; thirty-seven rows, five added at B34, T-0045-37 at B36; A3, E1 (B37, C2 on A3): T-0045-31's residual names two known unsound cases
The formal layer's method is declared: TLC checks, TLAPS proves, the prover is a trusted-base row

§4 claims every invariant is proved (exhaustiveness). A1: the certified configuration, twenty-one of twenty-four modules. A2 (B37, C2): two known unsound cases in the prover's translation, and that no cited result rests on either
The Listener labels what it delivers: a label on every item, a handle for what is suppressed
C4 · C2 for §3
Decides the sentence ADR-0037 §2 left open; CR-6, CR-32 in part. §3: a suppressed item's bytes do not enter the guest. New at G10
A Thinker learns its tools from the mechanism
Run's ingress a closed list of four where two ratified sentences said three; the list the only description with standing. New at G10
The allowlist entry has one schema
C4 · C2 for §5
Discharges ADR-0040's obligation on the entry's schema; §5: the entry is the one statement of a tool's channel. New at G10
An operator is a principal: seated by promotion, renewing under a lease, denying without one
C1, C3, C4 · provisional
Who may put a lease on the log. And that the record is in force without its central behaviour built: a first lease from a quorum (G10 §4)
Break-glass is an emergency seating; the floor's exception for it is retired
C1, C3, C4 · provisional
The replacement of a privileged path, and the retirement of a floor exception. Rests on ADR-0050; a seating prepared by promotion is not built
A second deductive method: Lean re-encodings, code transcriptions, the floor in Cedar's model; the Lean kernel a trusted-base
row
C4 · for refines(Seats) only
refines(Seats) gives the two Seats theorems a route around T-0045-28, ADR-0033's ratified debt; no ADR-0033 addendum cites it as a stage. New at G11

Highlighted: the record new to the set at G11, ADR-0053, and the two provisional in blue; the rows marked new at G10 came in at that cut. The bootstrap set, ADR-0024 to ADR-0027, is Accepted with no marker and cannot carry one; since A2 it is reached by the bootstrap review with everything else, before the rules it defines take effect. ADR-0029 itself is marked for A2 and A4 only. The twenty-six dependent amendments of Batch 34 were applied as marked, beside the text they change;

each depending on ADR-0050 or ADR-0052 is provisional with it (G10 §1.2, §6). G11 adds ADR-0046 A2 and ADR-0045 A3 to records already marked (C2); ADR-0054's ten pending amendments land in records of this ledger and are not in force (G11 §1.1, §4).

text.tspan: The ADR-0029 A2.5 line, carried since G10 (G11 §4; the 10.02 review's CR-28 (ii))

svg.text: None. Every record, amendment, proof, module and reference tree is one hand's, drafted or ratified by the genesis custodian with the assistant; no reviewer independent of the author has read any record

None. No confirmation pass has been run and no review attestation exists; the field has no manifest digest to name. The dated reviews under derived/ are the drafter's own, as are the review runs behind ADR-0046 A2, and do not count
under A2.1
G4 to G9 did not carry this line, though A2.5 (ratified 2026.09.25) asks for it.

text.tspan: The bootstrap reviewer's two new duties (ADR-0029 A4)
Accepted · provisional · what the attestation names

svg.text: Establish that the policy floor is fit, with which it is ratified (ADR-0030 A3). The gates show consistent, total, non-vacuous and minimal; what makes a floor fit is not written
(items 2, 87).
Attest to rules that include three provisional amendments, named as such: ADR-0024 A3, ADR-0025 A3, ADR-0026 A2.

text.tspan: What the trigger and the ceremony need

svg.text: Not drafted: waits on the genesis rules contents. Its shape is a lemma in both proofs below, proved of
the floor's definition and not of genesis contents. Whether a module is owed for the genesis seating is not
decided (A3)
Drafted and checked 2026.09.23, floor as ratified (R1, R2, R5, R6, R7, R9); proved 2026.10.02,
Anchor_proof.tla, 40 obligations, for every floor subset and epoch bound; certified (ADR-0046 A1), 2
resting on LS4; proved in Lean of its re-encoding (ADR-0053)
Not drafted: waits on modeling decisions about epochs, the vote triple and veto seats. Invariant
renamed by A1 from NoPromotionWithoutAllGrantSeats
Not drafted: same decisions, and a model of deciding before committing, which the reference had to
implement
Drafted, checked, proved (37 obligations) and certified; models X1, so it is frozen and succeeded by
BreakGlass_A1 (2026.10.05): EmergencyNeverChangesAuthority, 8 rows, 45 obligations, nothing
assumed, R7 not assumed, certified. BreakGlass is proved in Lean too (ADR-0053)
Bootstrap specification: partial, as at G9 (G11 §4): two of five modules, Anchor and BreakGlass, are proved, and certified; Genesis, RulesFloor and Promotion are still owed. Both proofs extend
RulesFloorBase.tla, live and not frozen (ADR-0046 E1), which has not caught up: it still carries bgScope and R6's bound of two (ADR-0026 A2; item 90). RulesFloorNV and its rev5 rerun are
precursors, not substitutes. The ceremony accepts a specification digest marked drafted-only.

text.tspan: The genesis bundle (§5 with A2.2, A3, A4; ToO §9)

svg.text: The corpus manifest at bootstrap, including the confirmation-required set
The TLA+ specification digest, marked checked or drafted-only
The review attestation (A2.2): reviewers, manifest digest reviewed, scope, findings disposition; the reviewer's word that the floor is fit
(A4), and the three provisional amendments named as such
The genesis rules, which issue no erasure roster, and carry the identity providers' keys and the first operators' seatings (A3);
resident with the mechanism release (ADR-0027)
The trusted-base declaration beside the custody record: the five modules rest on its rung-0 rows
Every key-holder signs the digest → issuance epoch 0. Without the attestation it is not a bootstrap
ADR-0029 Consequences; ADR-0026 §6 finding 5; ToO §9
anchor key-holders
counted grant seats
R2 minGrant ≥ 2
humans
disjoint by R5
Six if the author holds a seat: recusal raises the roster to three. Four was a property of the 09.15 model (custody (1, 0)), and too few
to check R1 (09.23). Operators: since A3 (provisional) the ceremony also seats the first operators, at least three in each domain at
the archetype, each with a Persona, a key and an independent identity provider (ADR-0050 §6); a person who operates and also
votes holds two seats and is two principals (§1). A solo bootstrap is not a bootstrap, and custody today is (1, 0).

Debts no confirmation repays are carried beside the ledger (G11 §4). Those of G2 to G9 stand, among them the checker's authorship, the prover's soundness trusted as written and the proofs the same hand's. G10 adds three: five records, twenty-eight amendments, six modules and their proofs, a rebuilt reference and the model it is checked against are one hand's, drafted, built, checked and ratified across three days with no second reader; two records are in

force without meeting their own conditions, which is what provisional means; and the reference was built to records before they were ratified, so for two days it followed text that was not in force and did not follow text that was. Of G9's six choices accepted in conversation, five are now in records (item 85). G11 adds: one record, six amendments and errata, three Lean packages, two liveness modules, two Proposed records with twelve pending amendments,

two modules, a floor stage and a rebuilt reference are one hand's, across five days; a trust root is kept in use with two known defects, unreported upstream; and the reference again follows text that is not in force. The debt is visible, not bounded.

Sources: ADR-0029 §1–§7, A1, A2 (A2.1–A2.5), A3, A4, B25, B34, Options, Consequences; ADR-0024 §6, A3; ADR-0025 Annex A-0025, A3; ADR-0026 §2 R2, R5, §6 finding 5, §7 finding 3, W1, A2; ADR-0027 §2, §4; ADR-0030 A3; ADR-0050 §1, §2, §6, §10; ADR-0052 §9; ADR-0035 Status note; ADR-0045 Annex A; ADR-0046 §4, A1, E1, A2, E3, E4; ADR-0053 B36, E1; ADR-0054, ADR-0055 (Proposed); every listed record's Status line and Status note; decisions/README.md; G10 header, §1, §1.2, §4, §6; G11 §1, §1.1, §1.2,

§2.9, §3, §4, §5, §6, §7 items 2, 66, 85, 87, 88, 90, 92, 100, 101, §8; ToO rev 15 §0, §7.1, §7.10, §9; glossary (Bootstrap reviewer, Headcount); spec/README.md; spec/bootstrap-results-2026.09.23.txt; spec/Anchor-proof-results-2026.10.02.txt, spec/BreakGlass-proof-results-2026.10.02.txt, spec/Anchor- and BreakGlass-proof-cert-results-2026.10.04.txt, spec/BreakGlass_A1-results-2026.10.05.txt; spec/RulesFloorBase.tla
